title: Measure Fargate cold start with the larger runner image and add an ECR lifecycle rule
description: The runner image grew from 688 MB to 898 MB with the RISC-V toolchain. Measure session cold start before and after, and add an ECR lifecycle rule (or cdk gc) so old CDK image assets do not accumulate; keep idle cost under 1 USD per month.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Measured on 2026-10-06 after the Rust deploy: runner image 1.47 GB (was 0.9 GB); a fresh Fargate task (0.5 vCPU, 1 GB) took 42 s to become healthy (about 20 s before Rust). Learn lessons run in the browser and are unaffected; only Workspace and Explore wait. Options: lazy/seekable image pulls, a separate on-demand Rust image, or warming the backend when Learn opens.

right_now_summary: Fargate cold start rose to 42 seconds with the larger Rust runner image; image cleanup is still needed.
